events.title: The Premier League ruled out the possibility of 레인저스 and 셀틱 gaining membership.
첼시 signed Juan Sebastián Verón from 맨체스터 유나이티드 for £15 million and 조 콜 from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 for £6.6 million.
Satellite TV's Rupert Murdoch British Sky Broadcasting pay €510 million for transmission of FA Premier League seasons 2004–2007.
PSV wins the Johan Cruijff Schaal , the annual opening of the new season in the Eredivisie , by a 3–1 win over 위트레흐트 in the Amsterdam ArenA .
맨체스터 유나이티드 signed 18-year-old Portuguese winger 크리스티아누 호날두 for £12.24 million from 스포르팅 and Brazil 's World Cup -winning midfielder Kléberson for £5.93 million from Atlético Paranaense .
첼시 signed Romanian striker 아드리안 무투 from 파르마 for £15.8million.
첼시 signed Russian midfielder Alexei Smertin from Bordeaux for £3.45 million and immediately loaned him to 포츠머스 for the season.
첼시 signed Argentine striker Hernán Crespo from 인테르 for £16.8 million.
블랙번 로버스 paid £7.5 million for 레인저스 and Scotland midfielder Barry Ferguson .

The first month of the season ended with 아스널 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the league with three wins from their first three Premier League games, while their nearest challengers were 포츠머스 (newly promoted), 맨체스터 시티 and 첼시. Meanwhile, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 lost the first three games of their first top flight campaign for 20 years; 볼턴 원더러스 and 미들즈브러 completed the bottom three. The race to get into the Premier League was headed by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , who were a point ahead of their nearest rivals Reading and 셰필드 유나이티드 at the top of Division One. 위건 애슬레틱 , 크리스털 팰리스 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 completed the top six.
